seed: A measured text box carries a few points of empty room on its far edges so the letters never clip. It used to show: the blue box round a label hugged it at the top left and floated clear of it at the bottom right, and W read four points more than the words were wide. This walk looks at both.

steps.note: THE TEST: the blue box sits the same distance off the words on all four sides. Before this it hugged the S at the top left and stood four points clear past the last letter and under the baseline.
W and H say how big the words are. Measure the letters on the canvas and the two numbers agree.
THE TEST: 100 typed into W leaves a box a hundred points of words wide. W reads 100 back, the words did not re-wrap, and the blue box is still flush to the letters on the left.
